words.gloss: upon merely being told (of one's need)

literal: Upon merely being told, the noble will be of use; like sugarcane, upon being crushed, the base will yield benefit.
translation: Noble people will help as soon as they are told of one's need; but the base, like sugarcane, will yield only when they are crushed and squeezed.
modern: தங்கள் குறையைச் சொன்னவுடனேயே சான்றோர் உதவி செய்வர்; ஆனால் கரும்பைப் பிழிவது போல நசுக்கிப் பிழிந்தால்தான் கீழ்மக்கள் உதவுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the generous nature of noble people with the stubbornness of the base. Noble people (சான்றோர்) require only a simple request (சொல்ல) to motivate them to help. In contrast, a base person (கீழ்) is compared to sugarcane (கரும்பு), which does not give up its sweetness easily. Just as sugarcane must be crushed and squeezed (கொல்ல) in a mill to yield its juice, the base person will only be of use when subjected to force, pressure, or harsh treatment.
